result:
`Enrollment` now refuses to save when the main advisor has no `AdvisementAuthorization` for the enrollment's level. I haven't run the specs or the app, so the new validation is untested.

- **Rule:** the new `main_advisor_accredited_in_level` validation in `app/models/enrollment.rb` runs on both create and edit. The error reads "O Orientador Principal %{professor} não é credenciado no nível %{level}", so it names the advisor and the level. The text is in `config/locales/enrollment.pt-BR.yml`.
- **Co-advisors:** they can be unaccredited, as the issue allows.
- **Rule 1 of the issue:** it needs no separate check. If the main advisor is accredited, at least one advisor is.
- **Open questions:** I made these calls myself.
  - Accreditation in one level doesn't count for another.
  - Accreditation has no validity dates, because the existing model has none.
  - Enrollments with no advisors still save, as before.
  - Existing enrollments aren't touched and are only checked when saved.
- **Existing specs and fixtures:** any that give an enrollment a main advisor without an authorization for its level will now fail. I didn't look for or run those.
- **New tests:** I didn't write the new test cases the issue lists.
